title: Checklist
wikitext:
The wiki is, and always will be, a work in progress. There are many pages that need more love, more details. And since this is a wiki, everyone can contribute! For example: * '''[[:Category:Clans|Clan pages]]'''. older or newer clans, it's always a nice touch to write a bit of the clan history, adding a clan logo, and a couple of photos would be nice! * '''[[:Category:Players|Player pages]]'''. same as clans! If you have information about players, feel free to add them
Head over to [[QWiki:Notability_Guidelines|Getting Started]] for information about adding/editing stuff in this wiki. The community thanks you!
